question: Do heuristic fragment yield estimates (0.517-0.65) from EXP-INTEL-33945226776 match actual DOM extraction on live WebArena Docker pages, and does Method 1 (element-count, shopping 0.365) or aggregated median (0.65) predict live yield more accurately?
hypothesis: Live fragment yield on WebArena Docker pages will be within +/-0.15 of heuristic estimates for at least 2 of 3 tested site types (shopping, gitlab, wikipedia). If live yield deviates by >0.15 from heuristic estimates for any site type, the heuristic method is not a reliable prior for corpus suitability decisions.
falsifier: Live fragment yield deviates from heuristic estimates by >0.15 for >=2 of 3 site types, OR actual yield for shopping is <0.30 (below Method 1 estimate of 0.365), OR wikipedia negative control shows yield >0.60 (above all heuristic estimates), OR Docker deployment fails to produce valid accessibility tree observations for >=1 task.
baselines: Heuristic estimates from EXP-INTEL-33945226776: shopping median_yield=0.65 (M1=0.365, M2=0.92, M3=0.65), gitlab median_yield=0.60 (M1=0.484, M2=1.0, M3=0.60), wikipedia median_yield=0.517 (M1=0.517, M2=1.0, M3=0.50)
Method 1 (element-count) alone: the only method modeling viewport coverage (0.45-0.65) and node pruning (0.06-0.15), giving lower yields: shopping 0.365, gitlab 0.484, wikipedia 0.517
Synthetic adapter baseline from EXP-INTEL-33925056324: element_recall=1.0 on 100-element synthetic observations (tautological upper bound, not predictive of live performance)
Structural suitability baseline from EXP-INTEL-33528832113: S1-S5 5/5 structural suitability without observation-format measurement
positive_control: Shopping task (consumer-facing e-commerce) should have highest actual fragment yield due to structured product data with interactive elements (buttons, textboxes, links). Expected: actual yield >0.40 based on Method 1 estimate of 0.365 with live DOM typically having more elements than heuristic estimates.
null_control: Wikipedia task (CMS, minimal interactive elements) should have lowest actual fragment yield. Expected: actual yield <0.60 based on all heuristic estimates (0.517-1.0). If wikipedia shows higher yield than shopping or gitlab, the heuristic ranking is inverted and corpus suitability claims are weakened.
measurement_validity: WebArena Docker environment must be deployable and produce valid accessibility tree observations (obs['text'] + obs_nodes_info) for all 3 tasks
Each task produces at least 1 observation with non-empty accessibility tree text
Accessibility tree parsing via research/intel/webarena_adapter.py succeeds without errors for each observation
Formatted observation string length is measured before and after REQUIRES_TRANSFORM pipeline (viewport filtering, IGNORED_ACTREE_PROPERTIES pruning, truncation)
Yield is computed as: elements_surviving_transform / total_elements_in_observation
Truncation is measured at both UTTERANCE_MAX_LENGTH=8192 and max_obs_length=1920
Viewport filtering is measured with current_viewport_only=True (WebArena default) vs False
IGNORED_ACTREE_PROPERTIES pruning effect is measured by counting elements with pruned properties
Task selection follows parent recommendation: one shopping (product listing), one gitlab (project/repository view), one wikipedia (article page)
decision_rule: If actual yield >0.50 for both shopping and gitlab AND wikipedia yield <shopping yield AND wikipedia yield <gitlab yield: verdict = SUPPORTS, C-CROSSSITE and C-LLM-INHERIT move toward EXPERIMENTAL with caveat that 3-task sample is small. If actual yield <0.30 for shopping OR gitlab: verdict = FALSIFIES, 2-site corpus remains practical bound and Intel should assess VisualWebArena/Mind2Web as alternatives. If actual yield between 0.30-0.50 for shopping or gitlab: verdict = MIXED, inconclusive, need larger task sample. If Docker deployment fails for >=1 task: verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID, infrastructure not ready for live validation.
product_consequence_positive: If live yield matches or exceeds heuristic estimates, the 812-task WebArena corpus becomes suitable for C-CROSSSITE and C-LLM-INHERIT integration experiments. Product lane can proceed with REQUIRES_TRANSFORM implementation (estimated 324 LOC) knowing the corpus expansion value is real, not heuristic. Graph lane can design cross-site transfer experiments using WebArena tasks.
product_consequence_negative: If live yield is substantially lower than heuristic estimates (especially if Method 1 shopping estimate of 0.365 is more accurate), the 812-task corpus expansion provides less value than assumed. Product lane should bound REQUIRES_TRANSFORM investment to 2-site corpus and assess whether VisualWebArena or Mind2Web offer better yield-per-task economics. Intel should prioritize alternative benchmark reconnaissance.
estimated_cost: Medium: requires Docker deployment (WebArena images ~5-10GB), 3 task executions with browser automation, accessibility tree extraction and analysis. Estimated 2-4 hours compute time. No LLM API calls required (observation extraction is deterministic).
expected_information_gain: Very high: resolves the central unknown from EXP-INTEL-33945226776 — whether heuristic yield estimates match live DOM extraction. This single experiment changes the product decision about whether to invest in REQUIRES_TRANSFORM for the 812-task corpus. A positive result (yield >50%) justifies corpus expansion; a negative result (yield <30%) constrains to 2-site corpus and redirects Intel to alternative benchmarks.
